description: Lightweight endpoint that returns ONLY a startup's contact emails (contact / partnerships / press) and social URLs (LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub, Facebook, YouTube, Discord, Slack, etc.) plus HQ city/country. Cheaper than get_startup (1 db credit vs 1 profile credit) when you don't need the full row. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.
name: get_startup_socials
title: Get startup socials & emails
